mapper.sql: d.id, d.name, d.description, d.sort_order, d.status, d.created_at, d.updated_at, COUNT(doc.id) AS doctor_count
FROM department d LEFT JOIN doctor doc ON doc.department_id = d.id GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.description, d.sort_order, d.status, d.created_at, d.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM department d LEFT JOIN doctor doc ON doc.department_id = d.id WHERE d.id = #{id} GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.description, d.sort_order, d.status, d.created_at, d.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO department (name, description, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{department.name}, #{department.description}, #{department.sortOrder}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE department SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
